violation_type.title: Employee record: Signed and Dated Statement for Orientation/Pre-Service training (26 TAC §744.1331(d))
violation_type.short_title: Employee record: Signed and Dated Statement for Orientation/Pre-Service training
violation_type.typical_finding: One out two employee files did not contain a signed and dated statement for orientation, and/or pre-service. One caregiver did not have a personnel form avaible for review in order to verify specific information.

finding_variants.text: One out two employee files did not contain a signed and dated statement for orientation, and/or pre-service. One caregiver did not have a personnel form avaible for review in order to verify specific information.
One of 10 staff files reviewed did not have signed documentation showing pre-service or orientation had been completed.
Two staff files did not have a signed statment for recieving orientation and pre-service proof.
Two out five employee files did not contain a signed and dated statement for orientation, and/or pre-service.
There were two employees missing their orientations to the operation.
